_about: Relations: one 0 to 100 bar per settlement, from the wiki's Relations page (bb_all/1670_Relations.txt), every row of its table and its nine bands. ECONOMY's contract_terms.json carries a nine-row subset (and four of nine bands); this file is the whole table, and the mechanism reads this one. Rows marked ours are ours (draft): the wiki states no theft cost, no guard rule, so crime sizes are mapped onto the wiki's own offence ladder and guards draw in the hostile band. Prices stay in price_table.json (sellCutByRelationAndSize); this file never prices.

bands.quote: Hostile 0 - 9, Threatening 10 - 19, Unfriendly 20 - 29, Cold 30 - 39, Neutral 40 - 59, Open 60 - 69, Friendly 70 - 79, Very Friendly 80 - 89, Allied 90 - 100

start.quote: All settlements start with the bar at Neutral.

drift.quote: Relations trend towards 50 and these minute shifts in Relations take place at dawn of each day. (applies to both decay and gain, so a settlement at Hostile(0) will take roughly 40 days to reach Threatening(10))

fortified.quote: Fortified settlements (Fortified Manor/Castle/Stronghold) are fully affiliated with their Noble House and do not have separate Relations bar

haggle.quote: Before taking a contract, it is possible to haggle for better pay. However, each haggling attempt will worsen Relations by 0.5 points with the settlement

drink_for_patrons.quote: Buying a Drink for the Patrons in the Tavern||+0,1

crime._about: OURS, draft. The wiki's page lists no theft. Each crime is MAPPED onto a row of the wiki's own offence ladder so no new number is invented; PAOLO'S 'you cannot even steal bread'.

witnessed_only.why: standing travels by witnesses (bohemia_standing.js); an unseen theft writes nothing

draw_at_or_below.why: the hostile band's top; the wiki says hostile settlements are not friendly and states no guard rule

board.why: JOBS 11/17 (rule 453 (1), 'how a town feels about him changes what that town offers'): the wiki ties relations to access, not only to price: 'Settlements and Noble Houses, which are the only factions you can have friendly interactions with (receive Contracts, trade...)' (bb_all/0724) and the fortified towns' contracts wait for a company of Professional renown (bb_all/0724, 1050). OURS on that: below Neutral a town keeps its three-skull work from him (cold, unfriendly, threatening: two skulls at most), at Hostile it gives him one one-skull job and no more (never an empty board, rule 335); from Friendly up it posts one job more (never over the board's max of 4). A read board stays what he read (rule 610). TUNING's one table section Y

haggle.why: JOBS 11/17 (rule 453 (2), 'pay he can push up at a cost'): Battle Brothers' haggle (bb_all/0441 Haggling): each ask costs 0.5 of the bar (acts.haggle), a success adds 4-11% (bb_all/0827: 3-10%), the hidden annoyance (3 to 6 an ask, out at 9) throws you out with the negotiation fail (-2.5, acts.negotiation_fail). OURS, the house's own rule for the street card (slices/BOHEMIA_CITY_WORLD.html BOHEMIA HAGGLE, 9/11: 'Two asks land. The third ends it.', told before, never a hidden roll): each ask lands 7% (the middle of the wiki's range) and costs 0.5; the third ask ends it, the -2.5, and that job is gone from that town's board until it turns. TUNING's one table section Y
